Title: Pokémon: Pikachu's Winter Vacation
FullTitle: ピカチュウのふゆやすみ
Plot: It's a blizzard of fun when Pikachu and the Poké-pals are on their own in a winter wonderland. Get set for a double dose of merry mayhem in two different mini-adventures featuring all your favorite Pokémon.
Tagline: Take Pokémon home for the holidays!
